LanguageData.VFEI2_BreacherCharge_Colonists.descripti: Insector charges towards the target, dealing significant damage to anything on the path. Will destroy any sort of defenses with ease.
LanguageData.VFEI2_BreacherCharge_Colonists.label: breacher charge
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Far_Colonists.descript: Fly to a distant location that you can or cannot see using a set of gigantic locust wings. Allows the gene carrier to jump over the walls, provided the area they are jumping to is not roofed.
LanguageData.VFEI2_InsectGlide_Far_Colonists.label: locust farglide
LanguageData.VRE_RoyalJellyInjector.description: Inject royal jelly into a willing subject using a specialized injector organ. If the gene carrier's royal jelly is currently regenerating, the injection will not be possible. Injection causes a tiny wound, but when injected, the royal jelly grants the target an immunity boost and a mood boost.
LanguageData.VRE_RoyalJellyInjector.label: inject royal jelly
